## 1. Overview

The SafeRE execution engine processes regular expressions in linear O(N) time with guaranteed bounds [1.2.3.4, 5.6.7.8]. As documented in version 2.4 release notes, queries execute in approximately 15ms. For further details on configuration parameters and error handling, refer to the [SafeRE Documentation](https://github.com/safere/docs/v2) and review the [Architecture Guide](https://github.com/safere/arch/v2). All operations maintain backward compatibility.
